cohort: 496 pregnant women, including HIV-positive women on different antiretroviral regimens and HIV-negative women as a control group
finding: HIV-positive pregnant women not on ART or ARV prophylaxis were at a higher risk of delivering babies prematurely (<28 weeks gestation) or with low birth weight (<1000 g) compared to HIV-positive women on ART or ARV prophylaxis.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 35.9 +/- 3.6 weeks (range 24-42 weeks)
birth_weight: Infants' birth weights ranged from 550 to 4900 g (mean 2.5 +/- 0.9 kg)
